summary: The 'Protocol Layer' of the application. Contains Zod schemas and TypeScript interfaces used by both Frontend and Backend.
context_hints: Modify this package when you need to change API contracts or Data Models
Timeline docs and the standalone Timeline skill are generated from annotations during Timeline plugin builds and shared-types prepack; synchronization tests fail on drift
Python models are generated from these Zod schemas

subdirectories.src: Source code containing Zod schema definitions.
subdirectories.python: Generated Python Pydantic models (do not edit manually).
subdirectories.scripts: Scripts for code generation (TS -> Python and Timeline contract -> docs/skills).

key_files.src/index.ts: Main entry point exporting all types.
key_files.src/executable-plugin.ts: Versioned plugin manifest and package validation for Cards, Providers, native multi-Action Generator documents, SDK dependency operations, invocation ABI, and immutable plugin bindings. Generator registrations inject package provenance but never a Host execution realm.
key_files.src/generator-v2.ts: Canonical Asset + Generator domain contract: semantic plugin-backed Generator definitions, versioned Project Generator state, exact revision inputs, Action Runs, and output commits without runtime-realm identity.
key_files.src/plugin-json-value.ts: Cycle-free JSON value contract shared by executable Plugin invocations and Generator definition state/parameter schemas.
key_files.src/generator-v1-compat.ts: Fail-closed migration adapters from v1 ActionSpec, activated Action Cards, and plugin-backed Custom Actions to Generator v2 definitions; exact plugin hashes pass through and runtime realms never become semantic identity.
key_files.src/project-generators.ts: Host-owned Project Loro authority for Project Generator heads/tombstones, immutable Generator revisions, Action Run requests/outcomes, grow-only started facts, and insert-or-compare output commits. Synced peers replicate these facts but must not mutate their LWW slots directly.
key_files.src/project-output-assets.ts: Project-aware exact output resolver used by Generator authority to reject dangling, inactive, or contract-mismatched Media and Document OutputCommits before terminal success.
key_files.src/workspace-bundle.ts: Strict portable Workspace v1 manifest and Host transfer wire schemas for workspace.json, tagged project.bin, generic SHA-256 CAS objects, provenance-only source Workspace identity, and opaque staged import/export capabilities.
key_files.src/document-assets.ts: First-class typed Document Asset contract: stable heads over immutable content-addressed revisions, human/agent/ActionRun producers, exact source refs, COW lineage, and revision-pinned attachment relations.
key_files.src/document-kind-registry.ts: Built-in typed Document declarations and body schemas, including mutability, projection contract, allowed attachment targets, and explicit standard product consumers.
key_files.src/project-document-assets.ts: Host-owned Project Loro authority for versioned or immutable Document Asset heads, declared-kind/mutability validation, revision insert-or-compare, COW, and attachment CAS with real-target and allowed-target admission. SQLite/body stores are projections or blob transport, not authority.
key_files.src/plugin-auth.ts: Declarative Provider account methods: forms, browser flows, installed-app imports, and renewal policy without vendor-specific auth kinds.
key_files.src/credential-sources.ts: Method-aware projection of Provider auth declarations into field, browser-action, and Host-action credential sources.
key_files.src/agent-annotation.ts: Transient structured annotation blocks that address editable Canvas, Timeline, and Director Stage objects, including exact text-quote selections and viewport highlight hints.
key_files.src/project-assets.ts: Project Loro authority for Project Asset membership and logical lifecycle.
key_files.src/assets.ts: Storage-free Asset read/publication schemas, including canonical L1 display geometry, rotation, duration, stream, codec, sample-rate, and channel-layout facts.
key_files.src/metadata-attachments.ts: Transitional legacy typed-metadata address for Project Assets and immutable Action revisions; it is not the native Document Asset attachment authority.
key_files.src/action-asset-bindings.ts: Project Loro authority for semantic Action media bindings, direct draft-input replacement, reverse reference checks, explicit unbind, and atomic trash-if-unreferenced.
key_files.src/canvas-action-asset-inputs.ts: Single compiler from editable Canvas node, prompt, and edge projections to semantic draft Action Asset input slots; shared by live writes and one-way legacy materialization.
key_files.src/trajectory-action.ts: Transport-independent compiler from a selected Canvas producing trajectory to an Action boundary with source/text input node references, step node references, output node references, and non-mutating invocation input rebinding.
key_files.src/project-canvas-preview.ts: Read-only Main canvas geometry projection for persisted project-card previews; nested node positions use the shared layout coordinate rules.
key_files.src/timeline-persistence.ts: Storage-free Project Timeline write boundary: strips Host projections when Project Asset identity exists and rejects URL/path-only media.
key_files.src/timeline-mask.ts: Implementation-side clip-mask annotations that generate validation, defaults, UI bindings, runtime constants, DSL metadata, examples, and docs.
key_files.src/timeline-keyframes.ts: Item-local transform and mask animation channels plus structural validation.
key_files.src/timeline-yaml.ts: Timeline YAML parsing and semantic validation, including mask/keyframe compatibility rules.
key_files.src/timeline-dsl-schema.ts: Versioned agent-facing Timeline YAML Zod/JSON Schema definition, feature semantics, and executable mask-keyframe example.
key_files.src/timeline-dsl-docs.ts: Deterministic JavaDoc-style Markdown and Skill reference renderer generated from Timeline capability annotations.
key_files.src/models.ts: AI Model configuration and metadata schemas.
key_files.src/tasks.ts: Task definitions for the Async Job system.

architecture_notes: Single Source of Truth (SSOT) pattern. Zod is the master definition. Model cards own provider implementation route metadata via providerImplementations; provider definitions must not reintroduce provider-supported model matrices.
